title: Search PowerPoint – Find Text in PPTX Slides and Notes
description: Search the text of every PowerPoint slide and its speaker notes in your browser, and see each match with its slide number. Free, no upload.
heading: Search text in a PowerPoint presentation
subtitle: Find a word in every slide and speaker note of a PowerPoint presentation, with the slide number of each match; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Search a PPTX without PowerPoint: choose a presentation, type a word and see every match in the slides and speaker notes, with the slide number and the words around it. Arabic and English are both found. Nothing is downloaded: the results are listed on the page. Works with .pptx, .ppsx, .potx and .pptm files. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Slides and notes
features.text: The text of every slide and its speaker notes is searched in one go.

features.title: Arabic and English
features.text: Arabic words are found as well as English ones.

stepsTitle: How to search a PowerPoint presentation

steps.title: Choose your presentation
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .pptx, .ppsx, .potx or .pptm file on the page.

steps.title: Type a word
steps.text: Type the word or phrase you are looking for.

steps.title: Read the results
steps.text: Every match is listed with its slide number and the words around it, under a count of all matches.

handles: The text on every slide and in its speaker notes.
Results: every match, with its slide number and the words around it.
limits: Text inside pictures, such as a screenshot or a scanned page, can't be searched.
Text in charts may be missed.
Old .ppt files can't be read; save them as .pptx first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I search for a word in a PowerPoint?
faq.answer: PowerPoint has a Find command for the presentation you have open (checked 24 November 2026). On this page, choose the file and type the word; every slide and speaker note is searched in your browser, and every match is listed with its slide number.

faq.question: Does it search the speaker notes?
faq.answer: Yes. The speaker notes of every slide are searched along with the slide text, and the results say where each match was found.

faq.question: Why isn't the text in a picture found?
faq.answer: A picture holds pixels, not text, so words in a screenshot or a scanned page can't be searched. Text in charts may also be missed.

faq.question: Does it work with Arabic?
faq.answer: Yes. Arabic words are found as well as English ones, in the slides and in the notes.

faq.question: Can I see the slides themselves?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the file in the PowerPoint viewer to go through the slides.

faq.question: Can I copy all the text out?
faq.answer: Yes. PowerPoint to Markdown turns every slide's text and notes into one text file.
